cobblemon.species.zygarde-1.desc: This is a single Zygarde cell that has much potential to grow immensily.
cobblemon.species.deoxys-attack.desc: This Deoxys has transformed into its aggressive guise, a tactic to fool enemies by altering its appearance.
cobblemon.species.deoxys-defense.desc: This Deoxys has transformed into its defensive form, a tactic to enemies by altering its appearance.
cobblemon.species.deoxys-speed.desc: This Deoxys has transformed into its fastest form, a tactic to enemies by altering its appearance.
cobblemon.species.mewtwo-armored.desc: This Mewtwo was equipt with a durable armor by unknown scientists.
cobblemon.species.arceus-bug.desc: Where all creation was born, that is the being's place of origin.
cobblemon.species.silvally-bug.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to bug type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.onix-crystal.desc: An unique kind of Onix made out of glass crystal. It's also unique from other Onix in that it can live in water without being hurt by it.
cobblemon.species.arceus-dark.desc: Two make matter, and three make spirit, shaping the world.
cobblemon.species.silvally-dark.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to dark type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.arceus-dragon.desc: Three beings were born to bind time and space.
cobblemon.species.silvally-dragon.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to dragon type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.arceus-electric.desc: The third being raged, raining down bolts of anger.
cobblemon.species.silvally-electric.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to electric type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.arceus-fairy.desc: The Original One is in all things. The Original One is nowhere at all. From all creations, over all creations, does the Original One watch over all.
cobblemon.species.silvally-fairy.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to fairy type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.arceus-fighting.desc: Three beings whose power can hold both time and space fixed. The rift is born of disorder on the other side of this world.
cobblemon.species.silvally-fighting.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to fighting type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.arceus-fire.desc: The power of defeated giants infuses this Plate.
cobblemon.species.silvally-fire.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to fire type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.arceus-flying.desc: The being poured the remains of its power into stone and buried it deep.
cobblemon.species.silvally-flying.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to flying type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.arceus-grass.desc: The powers of Plates are shared among Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.silvally-grass.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to grass type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.arceus-ghost.desc: The other side of this world was given by the Original One to its raging third.
cobblemon.species.silvally-ghost.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to ghost type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.arceus-ground.desc: When the universe was created, its shards became this Plate.
cobblemon.species.silvally-ground.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to ground type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.arceus-ice.desc: Two beings of time and space set free from the Original One.
cobblemon.species.silvally-ice.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to ice type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.arceus-poison.desc: The rules of time and space change within the opposite world.
cobblemon.species.silvally-poison.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to poison type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.arceus-psychic.desc: The Original One breathed alone before the universe came.
cobblemon.species.silvally-psychic.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to psychic type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.keldeo-resolute.desc: The power that lay hidden in its body now covers its horn, turning it into a sword that can slice through anything.
cobblemon.species.arceus-rock.desc: It gathers power from the Plates, listening for the flute's song.
cobblemon.species.silvally-rock.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to rock type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.lugia-shadow.desc: This Lugia has had the door to its heart shut by the criminal syndicate Cipher, believed to be the ultimate Shadow Pokémon and completely immune to purification.
cobblemon.species.mewtwo-shadow.desc: This Mewtwo was possessed by the Shadow Synergy Stone.
cobblemon.species.arceus-steel.desc: That which fills the other side of the world can shape the rage and mold it.
cobblemon.species.silvally-steel.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to steel type to confound its enemies.
cobblemon.species.necrozma-ultra.desc: Necrozma is at its full power in this form, radiating energy that has all sorts of effects on living beings and even nature itself. It is known as the 'blinding one' due to its brilliant appearance.
cobblemon.species.arceus-water.desc: The rightful bearer of a Plate draws from the Plate it holds.
cobblemon.species.silvally-water.desc: Upon awakening, its RKS System is activated. By employing specific memories, this Pokémon can adapt to water type to confound its enemies.

cobblemon.ability.teamcombo.desc: The attack move strikes three times. The subsequent two hits deal 15% of the first hit's damage and do not trigger additional effects.
cobblemon.ability.eternalrage.desc: Restores 1/12 HP per turn, while the opposing Mega Pokemon loses 1/10 HP per turn.
cobblemon.ability.eternalrageplus.desc: Restores 1/5 HP per turn, while the opposing Mega Pokemon loses 1/3 HP per turn, while the opposing normal Pokemon loses 1/6 HP per turn.
cobblemon.ability.jinglebells.desc: When using sound-based skills continuously, their power will gradually increase; if interrupted, the count will reset.
cobblemon.ability.moonshot.desc: While it is on the field, all other Pokemon on the field are put into Gravity state for 5 turns.
cobblemon.ability.sweetslime.desc: Poison the target even if it's a Steel or Poison type and can hit Steel type pokemons with poison type moves.
cobblemon.ability.ionbattery.desc: It floats up from the ground, thus avoiding damage from Ground-type moves, and the power of its Special Attacks is increased 1.5x
cobblemon.ability.retreat.desc: The Pokémon, sensing danger, switches out when its HP drops to half or lessAnd when it exits, it randomly triggers one of the following: lowering the opponent's accuracy by 1 stage, lowering the opponent's speed by 1 stage, or using Spikes.
cobblemon.ability.benevolence.desc: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows Benevolence, which boosts its Special Attack stat.
cobblemon.ability.squidnapped.desc: When it is on the field, the opposing Pokémon becomes infatuated with it until it leaves the field.
cobblemon.ability.aurapower.desc: hit Ghost-type Pokémon with damage-dealing Normal- and Fighting-type moves. It also prevents other Pokémon from lowering the Pokémon's accuracy and ignores changes to the opponents' evasion.
cobblemon.move.nihillight.desc: The user attacks by unleashing a powerful light that defies all laws of nature, striking even Fairy types and ignoring any stat changes affecting its targets.
cobblemon.species.barbaracle-mega.desc: Baxcalibur's dorsal blade has grown even more massive thanks to Mega Evolution. This Pokémon fires beams from the hilt at its solar plexus.
cobblemon.species.baxcalibur-mega.desc: Due to Mega Evolution, it can generate significantly more ice energy than before. it can use its larger blade's immense weight to cut through nearly anything in half or smash it to pieces.
cobblemon.species.chimecho-mega.desc: It vibrates its entire body to attack in all directions using sound waves. Any who hear the vibrations get so confused, they forget who they are.
cobblemon.species.chandelure-mega.desc: One of its eyes is a window linking our world with the afterlife. This Pokémon draws in hatred and converts it into power.
cobblemon.species.chesnaught-mega.desc: It has fortified armor and a will to defend at all costs. Both are absurdly strong.
cobblemon.species.clefable-mega.desc: It flies by using the power of moonlight to control gravity within a radius of over 20 meters around it.
cobblemon.species.delphox-mega.desc: It wields flaming branches to dazzle its opponents before incinerating them with a huge fireball.
cobblemon.species.dragalge-mega.desc: It spits a liquid that causes the regenerative power of cells to run wild. The liquid is deadly poison to everything other than itself.
cobblemon.species.dragonite-mega.desc: Mega Evolution has excessively powered up this Pokémon's feelings of kindness. It finishes off its opponents with mercy in its heart.
cobblemon.species.drampa-mega.desc: Drampa's cells have been invigorated, allowing it to regain its youth. It manipulates the atmosphere to summon storms.
cobblemon.species.eelektross-mega.desc: It now generates 10 times the electricity it did before Mega Evolving. It discharges this electricity from its false Eelektrik, which are made of mucus.
cobblemon.species.emboar-mega.desc: Brandishing a blazing flame shaped like a serpentine spear, it rushes in to rescue its imperiled allies.
cobblemon.species.excadrill-mega.desc: If this Pokémon brings its arms and head together to form a streamlined shape and spins at high speeds, it can destroy anything.
cobblemon.species.falinks-mega.desc: Mega Falinks has taken on the ultimate battle formation, which can be achieved only if the troopers and brass have the strongest of bonds.
cobblemon.species.feraligatr-mega.desc: With its arms and hoodlike fin, this Pokémon forms a gigantic set of jaws with a bite 10 times as powerful as Mega Feraligatr's actual jaws.
cobblemon.species.froslass-mega.desc: This Pokémon can use eerie cold air imbued with ghost energy to freeze even insubstantial things, such as flames or the wind.
cobblemon.species.greninja-mega.desc: This Pokémon spins a giant shuriken at high speed to make it float, then clings to it upside down to catch opponents unawares.
cobblemon.species.hawlucha-mega.desc: Mega Evolution has pumped up all its muscles. Hawlucha flexes to show off its strength.
cobblemon.species.malamar-mega.desc: It uses its colorful lights to overwrite the personalities and memories of others—and to control them.
cobblemon.species.meganium-mega.desc: This Pokémon can fire a tremendously powerful Solar Beam from its four flowers. Another name for this is Mega Sol Cannon.
cobblemon.species.pyroar-mega.desc: This Pokémon spews flames hotter than 10,000 degrees Celsius. It swings around its grand, blazing mane as it protects its allies.
cobblemon.species.raichu-mega-x.desc: It resembles an X as it flies through the air with 50 million volts of electricity sparking from its ears and forked tail.
cobblemon.species.raichu-mega-y.desc: It fires bolts of electricity from the tip of its tail and from the spiky tufts of fur growing out of its temples. This electricity forms the letter Y.
cobblemon.species.scolipede-mega.desc: Its deadly venom gives off a faint glow. The venom affects Scolipede's mind, honing its viciousness.
cobblemon.species.scrafty-mega.desc: Mega Evolution has caused Scrafty's shed skin to turn white, growing tough and supple. Of course, this Pokémon is still as feisty as ever.
cobblemon.species.skarmory-mega.desc: It flies faster than the speed of sound. After whipping up shock waves to send enemies flying, it finishes them off with its talons.
cobblemon.species.starmie-mega.desc: Its movements have become more humanlike. Whether it's simply trying to communicate or wants to supplant humanity is unclear.
cobblemon.species.victreebel-mega.desc: The volume of this Pokémon's acid has increased due to Mega Evolution, filling its mouth. If it's not careful, the acid will overflow and spill out.
cobblemon.species.zygarde-mega.desc: In response to people's emotions during an unprecedented crisis, Zygarde Mega Evolves and calms the situation with its unmatched power.
cobblemon.species.zeraora-mega.desc: It stores up 10 lightning strikes' worth of electricity. When it stops limiting itself, it's in the strongest class of electric Pokémon.
cobblemon.species.lucario-mega-z.desc: By completely cloaking itself in its aura, Mega Lucario Z can parry all manner of attacks, battling as if it were gracefully dancing.
cobblemon.species.garchomp-mega-z.desc: Garchomp has gained a new Mega-Evolved form. It flies around foes at Mach speed and cuts them to shreds with its sinister wing claws.
cobblemon.species.absol-mega-z.desc: Using fur that it has made into sharp, clawlike shapes, it cuts down foes with a single blow. This is an act of kindness to keep them from suffering.
cobblemon.species.meowstic-mega.desc: Mega Meowstic can use its psychic power to compress or expand anything. It overwhelms foes by contorting space itself.
cobblemon.species.floette-mega.desc: The Eternal Flower has absorbed all the energy from Mega Evolution. The flower now attacks enemies on its own.
cobblemon.species.darkrai-mega.desc: Its dark power blocks out the sun, plunging the surrounding area into darkness. There is no escaping its evil eye.
cobblemon.species.crabominable-mega.desc: It can pulverize reinforced concrete with a light swing of one of its fists, each of which is covered in a thick layer of ice.
cobblemon.species.scovillain-mega.desc: Mega Evolution has dialed up this Pokémon's spiciness. It swings its necktie around to wallop its foes.
cobblemon.species.glimmora-mega.desc: Glimmora's petals—now larger and separated from its main body—rotate around it to provide defense while scattering poisonous fragments.
cobblemon.species.golisopod-mega.desc: It uses four of its arms to fiercely assail its foes. Once they've been pushed to the brink of defeat, it finishes them off with the arms it kept hidden.
cobblemon.species.magearna-mega.desc: This is Magearna once a previously hidden mode activates. The emotions Magearna had begun to feel now hide away as it fells foe after foe.
cobblemon.species.magearna-original-mega: A mechanism to remove Magerna's limitations has lain secretly with Magerna for 500 years. This mechanism is triggered by a Mega Stone.
cobblemon.species.magearna-megao.desc: This is Magearna once a previously hidden mode activates. The emotions Magearna had begun to feel now hide away as it fells foe after foe.
cobblemon.species.magearna-original-mega: A mechanism to remove Magerna's limitations has lain secretly with Magerna for 500 years. This mechanism is triggered by a Mega Stone.
cobblemon.species.staraptor-mega.desc: Mega Staraptor is a top-class flier. It can easily soar through the sky while gripping a Steelix that weighs more than 880 lbs.
cobblemon.species.golurk-mega.desc: The energy within Golurk has been stimulated by Mega Evolution. The Pokémon could explode at any moment.
cobblemon.species.heatran-mega.desc: It's said that if it goes all out, it can heat its body up to temperatures over 1.8 million degrees Fahrenheit. This heat keeps enemies at bay.
cobblemon.species.tatsugiri-curly-mega.d: Tatsugiri's brain has been invigorated by Mega Evolution, making it even wilier. It can create and command copies of itself.
cobblemon.species.tatsugiri-stretchy-meg: Using the energy of Mega Evolution, it creates a dish to ride upon, allowing it to move with total freedom-even through the air.
It solidifies the energy of Mega Evolution, building up an overflowing pile to launch as projectiles. These projectiles explode on contact.
